points: 典型手法:用增值资产设立名义上的 CRAT,在信托内出售该资产,再用价款购买年金,并按「信托分配规则不适用」的口径申报年金付款。

title: Certain CRATs
are now a
[[listed transaction]]
sub: Treasury and the IRS finalised regulations identifying certain charitable remainder annuity trust arrangements as listed transactions, effective July 9, 2026. Participants file Form 8886; material advisors file Form 8918. Swipe →
footer: IR-2026-82 · T.D. 10051 · Source: IRS

reason: CRAT listed transaction · New disclosure duty
title: Who files
what
footer: Effective July 9, 2026 · Penalties apply for non-disclosure

reason: CRAT listed transaction · New disclosure duty
title: The structure
being targeted
points: The pattern: fund a purported CRAT with appreciated property, sell that property inside the trust, buy an annuity with the proceeds, then report the annuity payments as if the trust distribution rules did not apply.
Once listed, participants disclose on Form 8886 with their return and material advisors on Form 8918. Separate penalties apply for failure to disclose.
An organisation whose only role or interest is as the charitable remainderman is not treated as a participant, and is outside the section 4965 excise tax and its disclosure rules.
If you have CRAT clients, pull the formation and asset-disposition file now and test whether the facts are substantially similar.
footer: Source: IRS IR-2026-82 · T.D. 10051

title: New York taxes
nicotine pouches at
sub: From Sept 1, 2026 the state tobacco products tax reaches alternative nicotine products. The part clients miss: a floor tax on existing stock — count it Aug 31, file and pay by Sept 21. Swipe →

reason: Alternative nicotine products · Brought into tobacco tax
title: Three dates
to diary
footer: Source: New York notice N-26-2

reason: Alternative nicotine products · Brought into tobacco tax
title: Practitioner note
points: Alternative nicotine products are noncombustible products, other than vapor products, that contain nicotine but not tobacco and are intended for human consumption — nicotine pouches being the obvious case.
The rate is 75% of wholesale price, generally paid by the distributor. Wholesale and retail dealers are liable for the tax on units they hold if a distributor has not paid it.
Anyone importing or selling these products in New York must be licensed or registered as a tobacco products distributor, wholesale dealer or retail dealer before Sept 1, 2026.
The floor tax return is Form MT-200.5 — Schedule A for multiple locations, Schedule B for vending machines.
footer: Source: New York notice N-26-2 · Due Sept 21, 2026

reason: County tobacco tax · Change of collecting agency
title: Practitioner note
points: Etowah County: ALDOR is the designated collector from Sept 1, 2026 (cigarettes $0.03 per pack), reported and remitted starting with the September 2026 monthly county tobacco tax return, due Oct 20, 2026.
Walker County: the county commission self-collects from Oct 1, 2026. The September 2026 return — also due Oct 20 — is the final one filed with ALDOR; after that, file with the county.
Holders of unaffixed Walker County cigarette tax stamps must return them to ALDOR; refund processing may move to the Walker County Commission.

reason: Income tax · Form and treatment changes
title: Practitioner note
points: Federal side: for property acquired and placed in service after Jan 19, 2025, bonus depreciation is 100% of the basis of the property.
Illinois side: for tax years beginning on or after Jan 1, 2026, Illinois decouples from that federal 100% bonus depreciation under IRC § 168(n) — the difference runs through Form IL-4562.

Schedule M: from tax year 2025, certain retirement payments made directly to retired partners reported on Schedule K-1-P, and the beneficiary share of retirement payments reported on Schedule K-1-T, go on Schedule M line 14 instead of IL-1040 line 5.
Forms touched: IL-1040, Schedule M (lines 14 and 18), Schedule K-1-P, Schedule K-1-T, and Form IL-4562.
